text:
alex: Heads-up — planning a quiet-window tonight 00:30-02:00 UTC to roll matmul/quant kernel v2.3 (matmul-hotflip). Will be gated by canaries and thermal checks.
priya: +1. What are the canary slices? how many GPU slots?
alex: Start with 1% traffic on a mix of short-chat and long-seq workloads (~4 slots), then 5%, then 20% if green. Full cutover only after 30m steady-state at 20%.
dana: Patch notes: matmul v2.3 reduces GEMM memory by ~12% and adds a permissive fp16 path. But microbench showed a 2-4ms tail on >2k tokens in worst-case. Need fallback plan.
mohit: For rollback criteria, let's use: 1) token-latency P99 increase >10% over baseline for 10m, 2) error-rate (model timeouts / 5xx) >0.5% sustained for 5m, 3) thermal throttling events reported by infra.
jamie: Can we pin the older kernel on Dedicated region windows where customers have strict SLOs? I can push a pin for night-batch clusters.
alex: Yes — we'll pin region-us-west-2-dedicated and region-eu-west-1-reserved during the canary. deploybot command will be: `/deploybot swap kernel matmul-v2.3 --slices 4 --canary-seq 1,5,20 --quiet-window 00:30-02:00`
priya: please add the release-note blurb: "matmul v2.3: memory optimizations, improved fp16 path. Known: small P99 tail on very long sequences; fallback enabled."
mohit: ops checklist: pre-deploy smoke on staging, run `perfbench --workload longseq --iters 100` and capture perf snapshot. If `p99_tokens` > baseline * 1.1 then abort.
sre-bot: deploybot scheduled window created by alex for 1711112000. Reminder: runbook link https://internal/runbooks/matmul-hotflip
jamie: One more: ensure prefix KV-cache compatibility. If KV cache invalidation rate >0.1% after swap, auto-pin.
adex: (typo) ignore
dana: Also flag quant-born regressions: float->int quant path might change logits slightly; add smoke prompts with golden-check expected token sequences.
priya: I'll assemble 12 short prompts and 3 long prompts for golden-check. Where should they live?
mohit: Put them in /release/goldens/matmul-v2.3.json in the release bucket. CI will run eval and post results to the thread.
alex: Plan timeline: 00:00 — final preflight (staging smoke + perfbench); 00:15 — build artifact promote; 00:30 — deploybot run slice 1 (1%); 00:45 — metrics review; 01:00 — slice 2 (5%); 01:20 — slice 3 (20%); 01:50 — decision for full cutover or rollback.
jamie: Who's on-call for the roll? I can monitor telemetry from 00:30-01:30 then priya covers 01:30-02:30?
alex: yeah that's the plan. pager duty rotation: jamie -> priya.
priya: I'll be watching P99 tokens, model-error, and thermal dashboards. If I see a spike I will: 1) ask deploybot to hold, 2) escalate in this thread, 3) if confirmed, run `/deploybot pin kernel matmul-v2.1 --reason "rollback due perf/regress"`.
mohit: Documented rollback cmd: `/deploybot pin kernel <version> --region <region> --ttl 24h --note "rollback matmul v2.3"`
dana: Also check that the quant build hash matches artifact store. Last time a mismatched tag slipped through and caused subtle drift. Quick check: `sha256sum matmul-v2.3.tar.gz` should equal the release artifact listed in the changelog.
alex: Good call. I'll add an artifact hash check to the preflight script.
sre-bot: Preflight run started by alex at 1711112100. Staging smoke: PASS. Perfbench snapshot attached.
priya: Perfbench snapshot shows median latency down 6%, P99 neutral (+1%). golden-check runner queued.
jamie: if golden-check passes and no thermal events, proceed to slice 1.
alex: Deploybot slice 1 started: `/deploybot swap start --version matmul-v2.3 --slice 1`
deploybot: swap started for matmul-v2.3 on 4 targets. Canary window: 00:30-00:40 UTC. Monitoring enabled.
mohit: watching logs — no increase in timeouts so far. KV invalidation: 0.02%
dana: I see a small bump in tail for 1 of the 4 canary nodes at 00:35 (p99 +12% for a 6-minute window) — can we pause?
priya: pausing deploybot now: `/deploybot hold`
deploybot: hold acknowledged. Current slice frozen at 1%. Telemetry capture ongoing.
jamie: Can we run a focused repro on that node? tag: node-az3-gpu7.
mohit: starting repro: `ssh node-az3-gpu7 -- perf replay --workload longseq`
alex: Decision meeting in 5. If this is a transient background workload spike we can unfreeze. If it's reproducible, rollback.
priya: Repro showed same tail with perf counters: cache miss spike on matmul kernel path. Looks like a micro-alloc fragmentation on that driver build.
dana: agrees — driver/alloc interaction likely. Recommend rollback and mark as driver-incompatibility triage.
jamie: +1 rollback. Priya please run pin command and notify customers in release notes.
priya: Running rollback now: `/deploybot pin kernel matmul-v2.1 --region all --ttl 48h --note "rollback matmul-v2.3 due to p99 tail on longseq repro"`
deploybot: pin applied. Traffic reverted to matmul-v2.1 across pinned regions. Canary slice remains held.
sre-bot: Rollback executed at 1711112360. Incident: matmul-v2.3 rollback due to P99 tail on long sequences. Triage tag: driver-alloc. Created issue INF-4921.
alex: Thanks all. Action items: 1) block release until driver fix or kernel tweak, 2) add driver-alloc perf test to CI, 3) owners (dana + mohit) to investigate. I'll update release notes with the rollback and mitigation steps.
dana: I'll start a triage PR and link perf captures.
mohit: I'll reproduce locally and test a small allocator patch.
jamie: I'll update the on-call handoff and notify any Dedicated customers impacted.
priya: Closing the deploy window early. Re-schedule tentative retest for next quiet-window once triage done.
alex: Good work. Thread closed unless we need to reopen. :thumbsup:
